args.lesson: Five narrow Store queries (5 FETCH and 2 EXEC) gave one verdict per job. Screenshot, PDF/OCR and sitemap are dominated by official or free incumbents: DO_NOT_PURSUE. RSS feed reading (2 incumbents with 39-51 users_30d, no reviews, fragmented pricing, including a 0.035 USD start fee) and broken-link checking (one 53-user leader) are PURSUE_IF. RSS is still crowded, with 14 or more listings, so the only edge is low price, agent-friendly stable JSON and no start fee. That is weak defensibility. The EXEC print output was truncated after about 2000 characters, so write full results to the file and print only a compact summary. Next time, require 'incumbent with 20 or more users_30d AND fewer than 5 serious incumbents' before PURSUE, and treat price-only differentiation as PURSUE_IF at best.
